title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.


WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency


BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands


WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.


With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

title: Remote Data Entry Coordinator (Food Products)
description:
Data Entry Assistant — Pilot R&D (Remote, Full-Time)


This role requires English proficiency , both written and spoken.


The Vision

At Pilot R&D , ingredients are the foundation of everything we do. As a culinary innovation and product development company, we help food and beverage brands bring their ideas to life — from cookies to kombucha. Behind every successful recipe is accurate, reliable data.


Accurate ingredient data powers all our work — and you’ll play a key role in keeping our internal database (The Walk-In) clean, organized, and reliable as we work across dozens of fast-moving projects.


Who We’re Looking For

We’re seeking a detail-driven, tech-savvy, and proactive person who enjoys structured work, organizing information, and solving small data puzzles.

If you love accuracy, can spot inconsistencies quickly, and enjoy turning messy inputs into clean, precise data — this role will fit you perfectly.

You’ll support our Ingredient Sourcing team by reviewing supplier emails, extracting critical details (pricing, MOQs, certifications, etc.), and entering them into our system with accuracy and consistency.


Why You Should Join Us

  • Be part of a fast-moving, innovative food and beverage development company working with top industry brands.
  • Join a small, collaborative team that values communication, curiosity, and growth.
  • Play a key role in shaping a new, foundational position within the company — you’ll help define what great data accuracy looks like for Pilot R&D.
  • Work remotely and independently , while still being connected daily through Slack and team check-ins.


Role Responsibilities

  • Enter all ingredient information into The Walk-In , our internal platform.
  • Upload supporting documents such as specification sheets, nutritional facts, GRAS and non-GMO statements, and certifications.
  • Input supplier data: pricing tiers, minimum order quantities, lead times, and FOB locations.
  • Set up new supplier profiles and maintain contact information.
  • Identify missing information and coordinate with the Sourcing Manager and Coordinator to complete data entries.
  • Perform regular data cleanup and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Collaborate closely with the sourcing team to ensure smooth data flow and transparency.


Skills & Experience

Must Have:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and reading English skills.
  • Reliable communication and responsiveness during 9 AM–5 PM PST business hours.
  • Comfortable interpreting information from emails and attachments
  • Proficient in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office .
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable following structured processes.
  • Tech-comfortable and willing to learn internal tools quickly.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Excel/Google Sheets or database tools.
  • Prior exposure to purchasing, procurement, or ingredient sourcing .
  • Background in food science, nutrition, chemistry, biology, or lab work.
  • Basic knowledge of coding or systems integration.
  • Familiarity with metric units .


Our Values

At Pilot R&D, our work blends innovation and science with a spirit of integrity and collaboration . We value clear communication, honest feedback, and building relationships — with our partners, clients, and team members. We believe in working hard, staying curious, and enjoying the process — after all, we’re making food for a living.


Compensation & Employment Type

Type: Independent contractor, Full-time (40 hours/week)


Location: Remote (LATAM preferred)

Hours: 9 AM – 5 PM PST

Compensation: Starting at $1,000 USD/month (depending on experience)

Timeline: Hiring within 30–90 days


Application Process

Please email the following to Maria+ :

Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.DataEntry.pdf)

Cover Letter , including:

a) What interests you about working with Pilot R&D and this data-focused role

b) Specific experiences that show your attention to detail, organization, and reliability

c) How you stay focused and accurate when doing repetitive or technical work

d) What you enjoy doing outside of work


Well-structured, thoughtful applications will stand out. If you have any questions about the role or responsibilities, feel free to include them in your message.

description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.

  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks

  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um projeto global do nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , assumindo um papel técnico-estratégico dedicado ao Azure DevOps (ADO) e às plataformas de dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Trabalhar com estruturas de dados de média a alta complexidade em ambiente corporativo.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on com SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Transformar dados utilizando Azure Data Factory (ADF), incluindo criação e otimização de pipelines.
  • Implementar lógica e análises utilizando DAX.
  • Modelar dados (normalização, desnormalização e star schema).
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos DBT, incluindo criação de testes de dados.
  • Atuar com soluções em Azure para armazenamento, integração e processamento de dados.
  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes Azure DevOps: acessos, permissões, configurações de projeto, repositórios e integrações.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos para avaliar automações, integrações e fluxos customizados dentro do Azure DevOps.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico sobre uso avançado da plataforma Azure DevOps, incluindo escalabilidade e integrações com GitHub, ServiceNow e serviços Azure.
  • Criar e manter automações utilizando Power Platform (principalmente Power Automate).
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos em inglês.


O que você precisa ter

  • Forte experiência em administração de Azure DevOps (ADO) e pipelines.
  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate.
  • SQL avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência com ADF, Data Pipelines e orquestração de dados.
  • Conhecimento em DBT e DAX.
  • Conhecimentos de Azure Infrastructure.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica.
  • Perfil com forte senso de ownership e visão de dono da solução.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Experiência com Python ou PowerQuery/Power BI.

Certificações relevantes:

  • DP-203 – Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • PL-500 – Power Platform Developer Associate

Experiência em ambientes corporativos com estruturas de dados complexas.

Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção a detalhes.

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

Remoto.

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.



Our promise to you:


-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry


What we ask of you:


-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness


As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.


Who we are:


We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.


With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.


Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.


About the job:


The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.


Operational Management:

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.

  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.


Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system

Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage

  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET / Vue.js)

This is an opportunity to work on a sophisticated platform that serves customers primarily in the oil and gas industry with a proven 2-week release cadence.


This position requires an individual who enjoys having complete ownership of features from conception to production, encompassing database schema changes, backend APIs, and frontend interfaces, all with comprehensive test coverage. We believe in the "you build it, you own it, you ship it" philosophy. You'll work in an environment that values craftsmanship, modern development practices, and strategic use of AI coding assistants to amplify productivity.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across nine countries.

  • API Design: Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs with proper authentication, versioning, and documentation
  • Testing Mindset: Track record of writing unit tests, integration tests, and maintaining high code coverage
  • Version Control: Proficient with Git workflows, pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the stack

Desired Experience

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

title: Platform Architect
description:
Role Summary

The Platform Architect will serve as the technical “north star” for the design, integration, and evolution of the NexusOne data platform for customer deployments and large programs.

This individual will architect the platform, define integration points, and design scalable, secure solutions based on incoming enterprise requirements using the NexusOne platform. They will participate in architecture review boards and ensure that all implementations align with NexusOne’s composable, open-source design principles. This role is forward-facing and requires a customer-centric mentality.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and evolve the end-to-end NexusOne platform across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud environments based on customer requirements and limitations.
  • Design and designate integration points for data services, pipelines, orchestration, governance, and security layers.
  • Translate solution requests and business requirements into scalable, compliant architecture blueprints.
  • Lead and participate in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) to align deployments with enterprise standards.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and integration frameworks .
  • Guide platform engineers and client teams in implementing best practices for security, observability, and reliability.
  • Oversee the selection, integration, and tuning of open-source components such as Airflow, Spark, Trino, YuniKorn, Superset, S3, NiFi, Ranger, and DataHub.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to evolve the NexusOne “North Star” architecture and roadmap.
  • Mentor engineers and collaborate with DevOps, Security, and DataOps to drive alignment and platform maturity.


Must-Have Core Skills

  • Core Expertise: Spark, Trino, Airflow, NiFi, YuniKorn, Superset, Iceberg, Ranger, DataHub, S3.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: Terraform, Kubernetes (K8s), OpenShift (OCP), Docker, Linux.
  • Security & Governance: IAM, SSO, KMS, Kerberos, Encryption, RBAC.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus.
  • Programming: Java, Scala, Python (preferred).
  • Architecture Practices: Solution design, reference architectures, system modeling, scaling patterns.


Ideal Background

  • 8–12 years of experience designing or implementing large-scale distributed data platforms in regulated industries.
  • Proven track record as a technical architect or lead engineer at Cloudera, Databricks, AWS EMR, or similar open-source platform providers.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and operating open-source data tools across hybrid-cloud and containerized environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise governance and security frameworks (SOX, FFIEC, GDPR).
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills to influence architecture decisions across engineering and client teams.


Success Criteria

  • Delivery of a validated, production-ready platform architecture that meets client requirements.
  • Positive approval outcomes from Architecture Review Boards and internal security/governance reviews.
  • Defined and documented integration standards adopted by all implementation teams.
  • Successful enablement of platform engineers and developers through patterns, templates, and technical guidance.
  • Measurable reduction in deployment friction, downtime, or rework during environment rollouts.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

Nice to Have

⸻

Work Details

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller – Brazil

Location: Rio de Janeiro

Employment Type: Permanent | Full-time



Role Overview

A global financial services organisation is seeking a qualified Financial Controller to take full ownership of statutory, management, and operational finance for its Brazil entity. This is a standalone senior finance role with end-to-end accountability for financial control, regulatory compliance, reporting accuracy, systems optimisation, and cross-border financial governance.


The position operates as the primary financial authority for Brazil, acting as the key interface with global finance leadership, external auditors, tax authorities, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep technical accounting expertise within a regulated, multi-currency, international environment , alongside hands-on ownership of financial systems, controls, and transformation initiatives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full ownership of end-to-end finance operations for the Brazil entity, covering general ledger, AP, AR, fixed assets, cash and balance sheet integrity.
  • Production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial performance commentary.
  • End-to-end responsibility for statutory reporting, including preparation and submission of annual financial statements and all federal and state tax filings.
  • Ownership of the month-end and year-end close process, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness.
  • Development, implementation and ongoing monitoring of internal controls to ensure compliance with group policies, local regulation and audit standards.
  • Lead the full external audit process, acting as primary point of contact for auditors and resolving technical accounting and control issues.
  • Oversight of transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance in partnership with central tax teams.
  • Drive finance process improvement, automation and system optimisation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce close timelines, improve working capital efficiency and enhance cash flow forecasting accuracy.
  • Act as finance lead for strategic projects including business growth, restructuring, system upgrades, new entity launches and M&A activity.


Key Requirements (Technical Only)

  • Fully qualified accountant: CRC, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent .
  • Proven experience in financial control, controllership or senior finance leadership within a regulated, multi-entity environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP and international accounting standards (IFRS / local GAAP) .
  • Demonstrated experience leading statutory reporting, audit management and regulatory compliance .
  • Track record of operating in multi-currency and cross-border finance environments .
  • Hands-on experience with financial systems and ERP platforms (Workday or equivalent).
  • Practical experience with transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance .
  • Background in financial services, professional services, or other regulated industries .
  • Experience supporting international entities or regional finance operations across multiple jurisdictions.

title: Accounting & Administrative Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly capable Accountant to support the financial operations of MoveUp across multiple entities.


In this role, you will ensure the smooth running of daily accounting activities, reinforce financial controls, and provide essential backup across all key operational processes.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and reliability in our financial workflows.


Specifically, your role will involve:


Customer Billing & Receivables


  • Create, validate, and issue customer invoices
  • Manage invoicing workflows
  • Monitor incoming payments and perform payment matching
  • Execute customer reminders and maintain updated follow-up tracking
  • Maintain customer reporting and ensure accuracy of receivables data


Supplier Accounting & Payables


  • Verify and validate supplier invoices
  • Ensure correct accounting allocation of supplier expenses
  • Support the monthly payables closing process


Bank Reconciliation & Treasury Support


  • Perform reconciliations for multi-currency accounts
  • Assist with treasury tracking and cash flow updates


General Accounting & Reporting


  • Support the bookkeeping
  • Maintain and control analytical entries
  • Participate in quarterly closings
  • Ensure compliance with internal financial processes


Cross-Entity Support & Process Improvements


  • Contribute to standardizing accounting processes across the group
  • Participate in internal projects workflow optimization, workflow automation, reporting enhancement
  • Improve documentation and build a finance operational manual


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting
  • Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial workflows
  • Experience with Odoo is a plus
  • Solid Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Ability to work across multiple entities and currencies
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and autonomy
  • English required; Portuguese or French is a plus
  • Experience with international accounting environments is appreciated


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next Steps in the Process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for You


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.

title: Graphic Designer - Apparel
description:
Company Description

Founded in Los Angeles in 2023, BioBlanks is an end-to-end sustainable manufacturing platform leveraging innovative practices to create custom apparel for modern businesses and creators. It is no secret that "swag" and "merch" has become synonymous with cheap and undesirable clothing to be worn once and never thought of again. We spent the past 3 years building a proprietary process in downtown Los Angeles to create apparel that rivals your favorite luxury brand while ensuring that the garments are kind to the earth. We use traceable organic materials, low-impact dyes, and regenerative manufacturing methods to ensure our customers not only love our merch, but the earth does as well. And the best part? We handle every step from design, sourcing, production, and delivery to make sure our clients can stay focused on what they do best—building a killer brand.


Job Responsibilities

  • Lead design projects from initial concept through final production-ready files, bringing creative ideas to client briefs while ensuring every detail meets our quality standards.
  • Collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to translate their vision into compelling apparel graphics, incorporating feedback throughout the design process.
  • Prepare and finalize all artwork for production, including proper file formats, export settings, and color specifications for print.
  • Maintain organized project documentation in Notion and Google Drive, including technical sheets, status updates, and asset libraries.
  • Contribute to brainstorms and creative sessions with fresh ideas that push beyond conventional approaches to apparel design.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve design workflows, templates, and processes as the company scales.


Hard Skills

  • Proficient in vector and raster-based graphics
  • Experience in traditional illustration (hand-drawing)
  • Proficient in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma, including export settings, preparation for print, and required file formats (required)
  • Proficient in web-based tools such as Notion, Google Drive, and Google Sheets
  • 3+ years experience as a graphic designer (required)
  • 2+ years experience as an apparel designer (preferred)
  • Experience working with clients and managing projects (required)
  • Experience with color separation of artwork for printing (preferred)
  • Experience in a startup, agency, or small company environment (preferred)
  • Proficient English fluency (preferred)
  • Intermediate English fluency (required)


Soft Skills

  • Self-starter who takes initiative without needing to be asked
  • Excited to solve problems creatively and think outside the box
  • Strong team player and contributor to company culture
  • Low ego—open to feedback and willing to adapt
  • Not afraid to make mistakes and sees them as opportunities to improve
  • Obsessed with aesthetics and visual design
  • Highly curious with good taste and references within the creative arts
  • Highly productive with strong organizational skills
  • Clear and responsive communicator
  • Passionate about pursuing excellence in all work
  • Thrives on collaboration and constructive feedback
  • Responsible and reliable
  • Wants to grow with a company long-term and build from the ground up


Compensation & Job Information

  • Full-Time (40 hours weekly)

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

title: Senior Data Scientist / ML Engineer

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer (AWS / Terraform / Kafka) – Fintech Payments Platform

Location: Remote (UK/EU time zones)

Contract: 7 months (to April 2026)


Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, Kafka, GitOps, Cloud-Native Tooling

Focus: Platform engineering & solution build (not ops/DevOps)


About the Role

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join a major UK retail group building a new Klarna-style fintech payments platform. This role sits at the heart of the cloud platform team and focuses on designing, building, and automating the core infrastructure that powers high-scale financial transactions.

You’ll work in a highly technical environment, collaborating with architects, backend engineers, and security teams to deliver secure, resilient, cloud-native foundations. This is a hands-on build role — not day-to-day ops or DevOps support.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Build & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable, resilient cloud platform components in AWS
  • Own Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (modular, reusable architectures)
  • Build secure multi-account AWS environments following Well-Architected principles
  • Develop internal platform tooling, automation, templates, and golden paths
  • Support EKS/Kubernetes environments and microservice deployment foundations

Event-Driven & Distributed Architecture

  • Build and support Kafka-based event streaming and messaging capabilities
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and idempotent service patterns
  • Work with engineers to define infrastructure for distributed, real-time systems

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and distributed tracing (Datadog/Grafana/ELK)
  • Ensure SLAs/SLOs for platform components are met
  • Contribute to disaster recovery design, multi-region readiness, and resilience testing

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Enforce best practices for IAM, secrets management, encryption, and network security
  • Build guardrails, policies, and automated compliance into CI/CD and IaC workflows
  • Contribute to platform risk assessments and mitigation strategies

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with architects, platform leads, and product teams to translate requirements into technical designs
  • Work with developers to guide best practices for cloud-native builds
  • Mentor engineers in IaC, automation, and platform engineering patterns

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong experience with AWS (multi-account, networking, security, core services)
  • Excellent Terraform skills, building modular and production-grade IaC
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes / EKS or similar orchestration platforms
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies
  • Hands-on with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
  • Strong understanding of monitoring, distributed tracing, and observability
  • Ability to work autonomously in fast-paced, cloud-native engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or high-throughput distributed systems
  • Knowledge of Well-Architected Framework, security engineering, compliance
  • Familiarity with service mesh, API gateways, or serverless components
  • Exposure to Python/Go/TypeScript for automation or tooling

What This Role is Not

  • Not day-to-day ops or support
  • Not traditional DevOps or SRE maintenance
  • Not basic provisioning or infra monitoring
  • Not a junior cloud role

This is a platform build position: architecture + IaC + automation + infrastructure foundations.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer
description:
About the Role  

I am supporting a US healthcare client in hiring a Full-Stack Mobile Developer to take end-to-end ownership of their flagship mobile application. In this role, you will serve as the sole mobile developer , responsible for evolving an app that pairs with a Bluetooth-enabled pulse oximeter ring to capture overnight sleep data and securely upload it to the cloud.


You won’t be working in isolation—while you’ll lead all mobile-focused design and development, you’ll collaborate closely with a team of experienced C#/.NET backend engineers. You’ll also contribute to backend features related to sleep-study processing and data workflows, helping shape the overall product experience from device integration through clinical-grade data analysis.


This is an opportunity to own a critical mobile product in a modern health-tech environment, working with senior engineers to deliver technology that directly impacts patient outcomes. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), and be capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 

Key Responsibilities  


  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Implement and optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address Android battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Requirements  


  • Professional level English comprehension (spoken, reading/writing)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with Android battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level ), both written and spoken. 
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus. 

Technical Skills  


  • Primary:  Flutter/Dart, Bluetooth LE, iOS, Android 
  • Secondary:  C#, .NET, Azure, Firebase 
  • Tools:  GitHub, Sentry, PostHog, App Store Connect, Google Play Console 


What We Offer  


  • The opportunity to develop innovative health technology with real impact. 
  • Competitive salary based on experience. 
  • Professional growth and development opportunities. 
  • A collaborative team culture that values independence and initiative.

title: ML/Data Science Lead
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Science Lead will be responsible for defining the strategic vision, leading the development, and overseeing the deployment of advanced machine learning models and data-driven products. This senior role will specifically focus on student audience segmentation, predictive propensity modeling, and AI-enabled career advising. The Lead will manage a team of data scientists and engineers, directing the creation and maintenance of robust, scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions to significantly enhance student engagement, career outcomes, and overall institutional effectiveness.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Science Strategy and Team Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of ML/Data Scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Define the technical roadmap and best practices for all data science initiatives, focusing on model reliability, fairness, and interpretability.
  • Direct the design, development, and implementation of high-impact data products, especially those focused on segmentation and propensity models.
  • Advanced Model and Algorithm Development
  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms for complex student audience analysis and AI-enabled career advising, with a strong focus on predicting student behavior and optimizing engagement strategies.
  • Oversee the utilization of advanced machine learning techniques, including predictive modeling, recommendation systems, and natural language processing.
  • Establish rigorous processes for model evaluation, optimization, and monitoring in production environments.
  • Develop and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines to support all phases of the ML lifecycle.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Communication
  • Serve as the primary technical conduit among executive business leads, product management, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, strategic reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation.
  • Drive the adoption of new data science capabilities and gather feedback for continuous strategic alignment.
  • Release and Change Management
  • Coordinate comprehensive release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for ML model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered effectively.
  • Track and report on post-release issues, adoption metrics, and stabilization progress.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Proven ability to set technical direction, produce high-quality work, manage autonomously, and take strategic initiative.
  • Strong business acumen with unwavering ethics and a willingness to lead by example.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and in executive roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements at a strategic level.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing and mentoring a team of data scientists or ML engineers.
  • Expert-level experience building and deploying segmentation and propensity models in a commercial setting.
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
  • Experience with data manipulation and analysis using Python (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, GCS, S3).
  • Proficiency in SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers (e.g., GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab).
  • Deep understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, and A/B testing methodologies.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with media modeling audiences and digital lookalike techniques.
  • Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
  • Knowledge of educational technology or career development domains.


Credentials and Experience:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Minimum of 10 years in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

  • Excellent written and spoken English

Need to Have

What Success Looks Like

  • The Sales teams run with clarity, speed, and zero chaos
  • HubSpot data is accurate, up to date, and ready for action
  • Every demo, event, and partner follow-up feels personal and buttoned up
  • Reports and insights are delivered proactively each week
